submission.natural_language_explanation: Retrospective dip-band complement of a memorized completion detector: the negative pole sits near its GELU-dip maximum (~0.17) on ordinary word-onset, function-word and word-first-piece tokens (and, consulted, poet, chemist, diss-, car-) and is driven to ~zero exactly where the positive pole fires, on word-final pieces completing memorized multi-token units (penter, ident, ist of saxophonist, drama after action, based after a hyphen) and on a few whole-word triggers (rapper; grocer/mogul only in some frames). It reads the current token in left context (56% of input attribution on the peak token; Jacobian lens kurtosis 3.1 with no coherent promoted set, so no upcoming-token preparation): it reports that the current token did not complete a memorized unit.

Knightriders is a 1981 American action drama film written and directed by George A. Romero and starring Ed Harris, Gary Lahti, Tom Savini, Amy Ingersoll, Patricia Tallman, and Christine Forrest. It was filmed entirely on location in the Pittsburgh metro area, including Fawn Township and Natrona during the summer of 1980.

The film represents a change of pace for Romero, known primarily for his horror films; it is a personal drama about a traveling renaissance fair troupe.
